UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_NeedFramewo: This window needs Minidoracat UI Framework (API rev 13 or later).
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_PreviewHint: Left drag: rotate · right drag: pan · wheel: zoom · double-click: reset
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_PreviewNote: The 3D view shows this vehicle type's default look with every optional part. This vehicle's actual state is in the list above.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_ScriptMissi: The mod of this vehicle type is not loaded.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_CannotDraw: This vehicle type cannot be drawn in 3D.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_OptShowDock: Show the admin panel in the family Dock
Only admins see it. Turn off to hide the Vehicle Capsule button from the Dock.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_CAR_EXI: The server has the recorded vehicle loaded: it is still in the world.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_CHECK_S: Go to the spot first, then tick "I checked on site".
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_NOT_RES: This record cannot be restored in its current state.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_NOT_UNC: This record is no longer unconfirmed.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_BLOCKED: The recorded spot is not loaded or is blocked. Go there first and move anything in the way.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_SCRIPT_: This vehicle type no longer exists (was its mod removed?).
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_NO_SNAP: There is no record file for this capsule.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_WRITE_F: The server could not write the record file.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_BAD_TRA: This change is not allowed in the current state.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Why_ERROR: Server error; see the server log.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_SearchHint: Capsule number or player, e.g. 10023114, Bob
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_NoteHint: Note (optional), e.g. reissued the water bottles
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_PickRecord: Pick a record on the left.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_UncertainHe: check on site: car there = close it, car gone = restorable
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_CarLoaded: vehicle #%1 is loaded on the server
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_RestoreConf: Restore %1 at (%2, %3)? It comes back without cargo (the record lists it), and the old capsule can never be unpacked afterwards.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_LootNote: Only containers opened for the first time afterwards are affected; containers already looted do not respawn. The numbers go straight into the vanilla loot tables.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_NoSandboxRi: You need the sandbox options permission to change loot.
UI_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_LootApplied: Sent %1 change(s). The server updates the loot tables within a second.
